scope: Nearby state structure points, literal signal labels and highway access classifications only. Separate source queries have complete returned ID inventories, not a complete world survey. A structure point is not a bridge footprint; a signal point/label is not an assigned lane or a turn rule. Different CDOT layers share a publisher and are not independent corroboration. Do not infer no bridge from zero returned bridge points, or legal car entry from an arterial classification. Native coordinate registration has stated datum accuracy, not a certified error bound or connector cost. No grade, current legal/physical access, anchor adoption, route optimality or geographic coverage is certified.
